timeline.message:
Fix _terms_enum default indices options

This commit changes the default indices options of the new terms enum API
to be consistent with _search.
This change also fixes the shards statistics in the response when ccs is involved.

Closes #75155
timeline.author: jimczi

timeline.body:

Safe to assume terms_enum options will always be aligned with that of search?

reply.body: That's the intent of the PR, yes.

timeline.body: LGTM. I assume we don't need to add CCS tests for the failing scenario because the existing tests for IndicesOptions should cover this scenario?
